sloka: गृहीतधनुषो यस्ते तिष्ठे दभिमुखो रणे ।वानरेषु समासक्तम् न ते कार्यम् विपत्स्यते ॥६-२-१९॥।।
transliteration: gṛhītadhanuṣo yaste tiṣṭhe dabhimukho raṇe ।vānareṣu samāsaktam na te kāryam vipatsyate ॥6-2-19॥।।

translations.english: "The task of yours entrusted to vanaras will never be spoiled. Very soon you will see Sita crossing over the ocean that cannot be subdued."
